failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the standard-validation selector against a fixture whose non-goals declaration is absent or empty; the check must identify the missing declaration.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Verify that the authoring standard explicitly declares non-goals.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema or state changes; revert the validator behavior change.

slice_hint.state_transition: The standard moves from lacking an observable non-goals declaration to exposing one that validation can inspect.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted validator test observes an explicit non-goals declaration and rejects its absence.
